name: multi_item_with_modifiers
description: Customer orders two items, one with modifiers and special instructions.

transcript.text: Voice Test Kitchen, how can I help?
I want one Margherita Pizza and two Samosas. No onions on the pizza.
Got it — one Margherita Pizza no onions, two Samosas. For pickup or delivery?
Let me read that back: one Margherita Pizza with no onions and two Samosas for pickup. Your total is $22.97. Sound right?
